H13.value: UNUSUAL: today benign, forward repricing. Daytrade levels only.

H25.value: Surface calm masking event hedging. VVIX is the signal — respect it.

H27.value: Healthy vol unwind. Classic risk-on regime continuation.

H36.value: Transition regime — neg gamma may be flipping back to positive soon.

H37.value: Classic post-flush regime. Vol crushing as fear unwinds. Trend-follow longs.

H38.value: Standard neg gamma sell-off in progress. Trade with the trend.

H39.value: Grinding selloff. Patience pays — don't catch knives.

H4.value: Theta-burn day. Premium sellers love it; daytraders should size down or pass.

H40.value: UNUSUAL: vol up over time, today calm. Forward repricing under neg gamma.

H41.value: Worst-case for longs. All vol expanding under neg gamma = unhedged dealers selling.

H42.value: VVIX confirming = not over yet. Don't try to call the bottom.

H43.value: RARE: positioning for next-day shock. Get flat by close.

H44.value: Best long setup in neg gamma. VVIX falling = forced selling exhausting.

H45.value: Transition out of stress. Smart money done hedging.

H52.value: Late-stage warning. Smart money still hedging.

H53.value: Stress unwinding but neg gamma still active — use tighter stops than positive gamma.

H55.value: Best-case neg gamma regime for longs. All vol unwinding = relief rally.

IT8.value: γWall held (engine) — blank = GY uses the raw test

IU8.value: minVexRes (Min VEX above spot, VEX<0, IV High)

IV8.value: vbFail -- RETIRED 2026-09-27 (Giggles): the vol-bounce symbol only shows when confirmed

IW8.value: vSellUnsafe (neg/fragile γ: SUPPORT whose ARRIVAL vanna (JV) reads SELL >= BG94; IV top at the level clears it)

IY8.value: vexActFast (dealer vanna BUY/SELL on the fast IV direction)

IZ8.value: dexWallCap (S under a -DEX wall / R over a +DEX wall)

JA8.value: safeFbDist (3rd-row fallback: nearest SAFE locked level)

JC8.value: domVbuySafe (DOM support with vanna BUY of at least BG92: clears every UNSAFE)

JD8.value: oiSkew (P = put-heavy / C = call-heavy vs strikes within 10 pts; backer P-OI / C-OI)

JI8.value: vAlignSafe (neg/fragile γ, simplified 2026-10-02): 1 = override ON -- engine latch JR (blank JR = raw test: reversal flag, aligned arrival vanna >= BG94, DEX aligned >= BG100). Clears AMPLIFY, TROUGH, SANDWICH, BUMP, EDGE, LOWIVFALL, HIGHIVFALL, CHOPEDGEIV, ZACCEL. Never clears VFLAT. UNTESTED

JJ8.value: geoFallback (display only: shape of a strike with no other geometry tag -- Hollow = less gamma than both neighbours, Crest = more than both but under the Knoll threshold, Ramp = in between / ladder end)

JK8.value: vBuyResUnsafe (neg/fragile γ: RESISTANCE whose ARRIVAL vanna (JV) reads BUY >= BG94 -- vanna opposes the rejection. Min VEX NOT exempt)

JL8.value: domWallFlat (neg/fragile γ: DOM that is also a γWall whose dealer vanna is under BG91 either way or flat -- no flow behind the wall. Opposed vanna has its own warnings)

JM8.value: domPull (neg/fragile γ: level on the SPOT side of the DOM and within BG93 pts of it -- price tends to be pulled to the node)

JN8.value: minVexOpposed (neg/fragile γ: the Min VEX strike with opposed vanna at or above BG94 -- its blanket exemption does NOT apply)

JO8.value: oiSafe (ALL regimes since 2026-10-01: reversal-flagged SUPPORT that is call-heavy (JD = C), or reversal-flagged RESISTANCE that is put- OR call-heavy (JD = P or C) -- clears every GEOMETRY warning -- king node, accelerant (max gamma / min GEX alone), gamma peak, trough, sandwich, bump, gamma-shelf edge, Peak+; also passes the neg-gamma support gate (DM). Opposed vanna and the rest still stand)

JP8.value: oiZommaOff (OI level, ALL regimes; in POSITIVE gamma a Dex↓ (AJ) level is exempt, 2026-10-01: UNSAFE unless the zomma reading FIRMS the level -- zomma sign x slow ATM IV direction, the same test as the EQ zomma line "firming / strengthening / fading"; any magnitude)

JQ8.value: oiDexOff (oiSafe level whose DEX is not aligned by BG95: support needs DEX >= +BG95, resistance DEX <= -BG95)

JR8.value: vLatch (ENGINE-WRITTEN, neg/fragile γ, simplified 2026-10-02): ARMS after BG101 cycles of reversal flag + aligned arrival vanna >= BG94 + DEX aligned >= BG100; RELEASES at once on a break >= BG9 pts, opposed vanna >= BG94, lost reversal flag, regime leaving neg/fragile or new session; after BG101 cycles of flat/weak vanna, misaligned DEX, or off the locked list

JS8.value: zomDomSafe (POSITIVE gamma, 2026-10-02 Giggles): 1 = SAFE zomma-dominant level, either side, positive GEX, no other UNSAFE reason, and EITHER Min Zomma (most negative, outweighs the max) with the zomma IV reading (KC, on ARRIVAL) falling, OR Max Zomma (most positive, outweighs the min) with KC rising. Was Min Zomma only on the current fast IV. UNTESTED

JT8.value: dexDrain (ENGINE-WRITTEN, POS gamma only): 1 = strike within 10 pts of spot whose |DEX| is at or below 50% of its peak over the last 10 cycles, peak >= 150K, AND |VEX| at the strike < 100K (weak VEX). UNSAFE reason DEXDRAIN (HP/HQ). UNTESTED as a rule, 2026-09-30

JU8.value: cliffUnsafe (POS gamma only): 1 = dEdge Cliff geometry (CZ) with POSITIVE GEX at the strike (cliff on a put wall / negative GEX is exempt: held 62%, n=26). Backtest 2026-09-30, side-aligned cliff touches in pos gamma: held 28% / broke 39% (196 touches); aligned Greeks made breaks MORE likely. UNSAFE reason DEDGECLIFF (HP/HQ), REVERSAL label removed on the Master Dashboard. Neg gamma unchanged.

JV8.value: vexActArr (2026-10-01; BOTH regimes since 2026-10-02, Giggles): dealer vanna BUY/SELL expected ON ARRIVAL at the level -- resistance assumes IV FALLS on the rally to it, support assumes IV RISES on the drop to it; switches back to the current reading (IY) on an IV top (BG78), within BG98 pts of spot, and on resistances while Spot Up / Vol Up (BG99) is on. Drives every vanna rule (IW, JK, JI, JL, JC -- those stay neg/fragile only), the Vex backer / confluence point and Vxi in BOTH regimes. UNTESTED

JW8.value: zomBack ARRIVAL (reads KC, the assumed arrival IV direction): kept for reference only since 2026-10-05 -- the confluence count, backer text, resistance qualification (CU) and neg-gamma support gate (DM) all read LA (fast IV) now

JX8.value: zshBack (2026-10-01, Giggles, BOTH regimes): 1 = the Zsh backer counts -- zomma-shelf edge (BE, or the GP hold) AND zomma firming on the FAST IV direction (BG80, else D5), the same test as the Zom backer (JW). Flat IV = not counted. Read by confluence (AM), backer text (C) and the reaction-table backers (KNM V/BQ). UNTESTED

JY8.value: vFlatUnsafe (neg/fragile γ, 2026-10-02, Giggles): 1 = spot within BG98 pts of the level and the FAST ATM IV direction (BG80; slow D5 while building) is flat -- no dealer vanna flow at the level. UNSAFE on EVERY level, no exemptions (Min VEX, DOM, vol bounce, put walls all yield). HQ token VFLAT. UNTESTED

JZ8.value: callWall (neg/fragile γ resistance, 2026-10-02, Giggles): 1 = positive GEX among the top BG102 positive-GEX strikes on the board AND call-heavy (call OI >= BG103 and more calls than puts). Positive DEX counts as ALIGNED (JI / engine latch); exempt from BUMP, SANDWICH and OIDEX; never absorbed into a negative-GEX neighbour (BK). Opposed / flat vanna and every other warning still apply. Prompted by 7645 on 2026-10-01. UNTESTED

KA8.value: accUnderCW (neg/fragile γ resistance, 2026-10-02, Giggles): the call-wall strike (JZ) within BG104 pts ABOVE this negative-GEX resistance, else 0. The level STAYS in the reaction table but is UNSAFE (hard reason, no exemptions): 'Accelerant under call wall -- price runs through to it'. HQ token ACCUNDERCW. Prompted by 7640 under 7645 on 2026-10-01. UNTESTED

KB8.value: accBelow (display): on a call wall, the accelerating wall it sits on (KA points here), else 0 -- shown on the call wall's line as '▲ accelerant N below'

KC8.value: zomIVarr (2026-10-02/03, Giggles; BOTH regimes): IV direction every ZOMMA reading uses (CF/CG/CH, EQ + Zomma column, JW Zom, JX Zsh, JP OI rule, GT sandwich, ZACCEL, IV-falling warnings). ON ARRIVAL -- support assumes IV RISES (UP), resistance assumes IV FALLS (DOWN); back to the current FAST reading within BG98 pts and on resistances while Spot Up / Vol Up (BG99) is on. NEG/FRAGILE gamma, 2026-10-03: the Max Zomma strike (BG105) reads UP and the Min Zomma strike (BG87) reads DOWN beyond BG98 pts, either side -- mirrors the positive-gamma Max/Min rules (always firming). UNTESTED

KG8.value: gDex (2026-10-03, Giggles; BOTH regimes): isolated DEX at a POSITIVE-GEX strike -- the strike's DEX has the opposite sign to both neighbours (which share a sign) and |DEX| > 10% of their average |DEX| (iDex's size floor); either DEX sign, supports and resistances alike. +1 confluence (backer token gDex), sets the reversal flag in any regime, and SUPPRESSES iDex at the same strike (one island counted once). Top/bottom rows can't qualify. Evidence: 50 touches -- UNTESTED, on the pre-registration list

KH8.value: safeSrc (2026-10-03, Giggles; for the archive safe_src column): which rule makes this level SAFE when it is not UNSAFE -- WZDOM (KM), VLATCH (vanna override, JI), ZOMSAFE (Min/Max Zomma, JS), DOMBUY (JC), OIRULE (JO, OI rule), VOLBOUNCE (GV), MINVEX, CALLWALL; blank otherwise TROUGHNEG (trough, neg/fragile gamma).

KK8.value: dataGapLvl: 1 = this strike or a neighbour 5 pts either side is incomplete (KJ). No reversal flag; the structure backers (Dex↓, γSh, Zsh, dEdge, oEdge, iDex, gDex, Vxi, Spi) do not count; UNSAFE 'Data incomplete' (HQ token DATAGAP, hard, no exemptions). UNTESTED

KL8.value: dataGapOI: 1 = any strike within 10 pts is incomplete -- the P-OI / C-OI skew backer (median of strikes within 10 pts) does not count

KM8.value: wzDom (2026-10-04, Giggles; NEG/FRAGILE gamma only; UNTESTED, pre-registered): 1 = SUPPORT that is a put OPEN-INTEREST wall (Master Dashboard AN16:AN18; a gamma put wall alone does not qualify) + the Max Zomma strike (BG105) + DOM tag (FA), or RESISTANCE that is a call OI wall (AN13:AN15) + the Min Zomma strike (BG87) + DOM. Sets the reversal flag (AN) and makes the level SAFE irrespective of vanna (incl. vanna flat); clears every UNSAFE reason except Data incomplete (KK). safe_src WZDOM. 2026-10-01 7650 19:00-19:14

KN8.value: gDexVannaRaw (2026-10-05, Giggles; POSITIVE gamma only, not fragile): 1 = reversal-flagged level (AN) whose flag comes from gDex (KG) and whose ARRIVAL vanna (JV) does not support the move (resistance not SELL / support not BUY, any size). Prompted by 7710 on 2026-10-02. UNTESTED

KO8.value: gDexVannaLatch (2026-10-05, Giggles): written by the engine -- KN held with hysteresis, on after 2 cycles in a row, off after 2 cycles without it (GDV_HOLD). Blank = no engine latch -> KP uses the raw KN. Do not type here.

KP8.value: gDexVanna (effective, any reversal source; read by KR / KS): KO when the engine wrote it -- still gated on positive gamma, not fragile, and no data gap (KK) -- else the raw KN. UNTESTED

KQ8.value: gDexOnly (2026-10-05, Giggles): 1 = gDex (KG) is the ONLY source of this strike's reversal flag (AN) -- no dexDrop, dEdge, oEdge or iDex clause of AN fires. KR needs it. Not latched

KR8.value: gDexRule (2026-10-05, Giggles): 1 = KP (gDex level, vanna not aligned, latched) AND gDex is the ONLY reversal source (KQ). This is the UNSAFE reason: read by HP, HQ (token GDEXVANNA) and the reaction table. UNTESTED

KS8.value: gDexAlso (2026-10-05, Giggles; display only): 1 = KP but gDex is NOT the only reversal source, and the level is UNSAFE anyway (HP) -- the reaction table then also lists 'Vanna not aligned (gDex rule)' for the full picture. Never makes a level UNSAFE

KT8.value: dexDrainEff (2026-10-05, Giggles; POSITIVE gamma, supports and resistances): 1 = the engine's DEX-drain flag (JT) AND the strike's |DEX| is still under BG108 (1,000K). At or above BG108 the strike is still a wall (call wall and such) and stays SAFE despite the drain. Read by HP, HQ (token DEXDRAIN) and the reaction-table DEX-draining warning. Size gate not latched. UNTESTED

KU8.value: dexFallAbove (2026-10-05, Giggles): (|DEX here| - |DEX at the strike 5 pts ABOVE|) / |DEX here|. 1 = DEX vanishes above, 0 = same, negative = more DEX above. Read by HW

KV8.value: dexFallBelow (2026-10-05, Giggles): (|DEX here| - |DEX at the strike 5 pts BELOW|) / |DEX here|. Read by HW

KW8.value: dexLeanRaw (2026-10-05, Giggles): the two-sided DEX lean BEFORE the reversal-wall check -- same test as HW (1 = support leaning down, -1 = resistance leaning up). Read by KX

KX8.value: dexLeanWall (2026-10-05, Giggles): 1 = the DEX lean (KW) would make this level UNSAFE, but the strike directly BEHIND it (below a support, above a resistance) carries the reversal flag (AN) AND more |DEX| than the level itself -- so HW does NOT mark it UNSAFE and the reaction table shows 'SAFE' with the reason. 7615 on 2026-09-17 qualifies (7610 behind: 906K > 577K); 7690 on 2026-09-30 does not (7685 behind: 783K < 4.28M) and stays UNSAFE. safe_src DEXLEANWALL. UNTESTED

KY8.value: spdStar (2026-10-05; hold 2026-10-07, Giggles): 1 = Spd★ backer -- support at the Min Speed strike (BG119) or resistance at the Max Speed strike (BG118). POSITIVE gamma (not fragile) only: also 1 when the strike was Min/Max Speed in either of the previous 2 cycles (engine-written BG123:BG126) and its speed is still side-aligned (negative on a support, positive on a resistance); switch BG127. KZ8.value: dexLeanPosSafe (2026-10-05, Giggles; POSITIVE gamma): 1 = support with the DEX lean (KW = 1, sharper fall-off above) but POSITIVE DEX at the level -- not UNSAFE; reaction table shows SAFE with 'clean bounces less likely in positive gamma · however DEX supportive'. LA8.value: zomBackNow (2026-10-05, Giggles; BOTH regimes): 1 = Zom backer -- zomma size mark (AL) AND zomma firming the level on the FAST IV direction (BG80, else D5) right now. LF8.value: spdHeld (2026-10-07, Giggles): 1 = Spd★ (KY) is on only because of the positive-gamma 2-cycle hold -- the strike is not Min/Max Speed this cycle. UNTESTED

LG8.value: nearTie / stacked (2026-10-07, Giggles; DISPLAY ONLY, both regimes): ladder tag = LH & LI & LJ -- only a strike directly next to the extreme (within BG136 pts) and within BG128 of its value; VEX also needs |VEX| >= BG135. LH8.value: nearTie speed: within BG128 of Max (≈S↑) / Min (≈S↓) Speed, with the gap

LI8.value: nearTie VEX: within BG128 of Max (≈⫪) / Min (≈⟂) VEX, with the gap

LJ8.value: nearTie zomma: within BG128 of Max / Min Zomma (≈ζ), with the gap

LK8.value: spdText (2026-10-07): backer text for Spd★ -- 'Spd★(held) ' when LF = 1, 'Spd★ ' when KY = 1, else blank (read by the backer lists)

LL8.value: stackShade (2026-10-07, Giggles; display only): ladder shading for a STACKED Speed or VEX strike -- copies its extreme's shading: 1 = green (extreme is a support row in the reaction table), 2 = pink (resistance row), 0 = none (extreme not shaded, or hidden by Hide unsafe). Zomma stacks are tagged but never shaded (heavy zomma stacks chop)

LM8.value: tpOnly (2026-10-07, Giggles; POSITIVE gamma, not fragile; display only): 2 = TAKE PROFIT · DON'T SHORT, 1 = TAKE PROFIT · DON'T BUY (switch BG141) -- the NEAREST locked level on that side of spot when EITHER it is UNSAFE because of the DEX wall cap (IZ) OR VEX >= BG142 works against it on the current fast IV (LP, 2-cycle engine hold). At most one per side. Amber + 'TP' on the ladder. Not counted. UNTESTED

LN8.value: vexBreakRaw (2026-10-07, Giggles; POSITIVE gamma, not fragile): 1 = |VEX| >= BG142 and the CURRENT fast IV (BG80) makes dealer vanna work against the level -- resistance: dealers BUY (VEX>0 & IV down, or VEX<0 & IV up); support: dealers SELL. Flat IV = 0. UNTESTED

LO8.value: vexBreakLatch (ENGINE-WRITTEN): LN held with hysteresis -- on after BG143 cycles in a row, off after BG143 cycles without it. Blank = no engine, LP uses the raw LN

LP8.value: vexBreak (effective): LO when the engine wrote it, else LN; positive gamma only. Makes the level a take-profit level (LM) with breakout / breakdown risk

LR8.value: swEdgeSup (2026-10-07, Giggles; NEGATIVE gamma): 1 = a SUPPORT directly below a sandwich (sandwich 5 pts above it) with zomma >= BG144, not itself a sandwich. SUPPORTS ONLY from this version -- the resistance mirror was withdrawn (8 touches at >= 1M; 7775 broke on 10-07 while it would have read SAFE). Floor reason for the support rows (CV, DM), exempt from 'No reversal flag' (IS) and the vanna warnings (JY, IW), +1 backer 'SAND' (AM), no 2-backer minimum (CV), zomma read as firming (KC). Ladder tag for both sides is MA. UNTESTED

LS8.value: swNearMiss (2026-10-07, Giggles; NEGATIVE gamma; display only): 1 = the support directly below / resistance directly above a sandwich that is NOT a SAND✓ level because its zomma is under BG144 (or negative). Drives the Neg-γ note '• Next to sandwich N · zomma … — needs ≥ 1.0M, not a SAND✓ level'

LT8.value: dexRunUp (2026-10-07): count of consecutive strikes from here UP with DEX <= -BG145 (negative-DEX run)

LU8.value: dexRunUpSum: total DEX of that run

LV8.value: dexRunDown: count of consecutive strikes from here DOWN with DEX >= +BG145 (positive-DEX run)

LW8.value: dexRunDownSum: total DEX of that run

LX8.value: dexStackTP -- RETIRED 2026-10-07 (Giggles): always 0. The negative-DEX stack sits above spot in most negative-gamma sessions, so the marker was nearly always on; archive edge weak (41% vs 47%) and 'DON'T SHORT' contradicted a stack that caps rallies. LT:LW / LY:LZ / BG145:BG148 kept for reference only

LY8.value: dexStackStartAbove: the strike (else 0) when it is the lowest strike above spot of a negative-DEX run of >= BG148

LZ8.value: dexStackStartBelow: the strike (else 0) when it is the highest strike below spot of a positive-DEX run of >= BG148

MA8.value: sandTag (2026-10-07, Giggles; NEGATIVE gamma; DISPLAY ONLY): 1 = the ladder's ' SAND✓' tag -- side-aligned: a SUPPORT directly below a sandwich or a RESISTANCE directly above one, with zomma >= BG144 (1M). 2026-10-08: never on a zigzag-UNSAFE strike (MH = 1: chop interior, or a zigzag edge facing inward). Only the SUPPORT side (LR) carries the rules; the resistance tag is information only

MB8.value: sandLock (ENGINE-WRITTEN, 2026-10-08, Giggles; NEGATIVE gamma): 1 = a SAND✓ support (LR) that is SAFE, ALREADY in the support rows, with spot within 5 pts of it, is LOCKED: it keeps its row and slot (even if it leaves the locked list or loses backers) and vanna SELL / vanna flat / zomma acceleration can't make it UNSAFE. The lock holds a slot the level already earned -- it never creates one. Releases on a break (spot 3+ pts below for 2 cycles), spot 5+ pts above, losing SAND✓, leaving negative gamma, or a new session. A structural UNSAFE reason releases the lock on the next cycle (the engine reads HP; the workbook can't, HP depends on the row qualification). Backers are never added for the lock. Engine reads the previous calc (one-cycle lag). UNTESTED

MC8.value: zzUp (2026-10-08): count of strikes from here UP whose GEX sign alternates (+,-,+...)

MD8.value: zzDown: count of strikes from here DOWN whose GEX sign alternates

ME8.value: zigzag interior (Giggles; NEGATIVE gamma): GEX sign opposite to BOTH neighbours inside an alternating run of >= 4 strikes -- chop, never traded

MF8.value: zigzag bottom edge: lowest strike of an alternating run of >= 4 (same sign below it) -- fine as SUPPORT, UNSAFE as resistance

MG8.value: zigzag top edge: highest strike of an alternating run of >= 4 -- fine as RESISTANCE, UNSAFE as support

MH8.value: zigzagUnsafe (2026-10-08, Giggles; NEGATIVE gamma, no minimum GEX size): 1 = interior strike, or bottom edge acting as resistance, or top edge acting as support. A hard UNSAFE reason (no override clears it). HQ token ZIGZAG. UNTESTED

MJ8.value: bottom-edge strike above spot (else 0) -- nearest one is the zigzag TAKE PROFIT for longs (BG149)

MK8.value: top-edge strike below spot (else 0) -- nearest one is the zigzag TAKE PROFIT for shorts (BG150)

ML8.value: pocketTPup (2026-10-09, Giggles; NEGATIVE gamma; DISPLAY ONLY): a negative-GEX strike ABOVE spot with a positive-GEX pocket directly above it (1-4 positive strikes, then negative GEX again) = number of pocket strikes, else 0. The nearest one (BG155) is the TAKE PROFIT for longs (LM = 2). UNTESTED -- archive: rallies into the strike below a pocket turned back 52% (n=29) vs 45% for other negative-GEX strikes, not significant

MM8.value: pocketTPdn (2026-10-09, Giggles; NEGATIVE gamma; DISPLAY ONLY): a negative-GEX strike BELOW spot with a positive-GEX pocket directly below it (1-4 positive strikes, then negative GEX again) = number of pocket strikes, else 0. The nearest one (BG156) is the TAKE PROFIT for shorts (LM = 1). UNTESTED

MP8.value: pocketTP code for LM: 2 = TAKE PROFIT for longs (BG155), 1 = for shorts (BG156), else 0 (NEGATIVE gamma)

MQ8.value: dexDropRaw (2026-10-09): the original Dex↓ test, unchanged -- support: DEX 5 pts BELOW at least 40% smaller in size; resistance: DEX 5 pts ABOVE at least 40% smaller. AJ (Dex↓) = this unless MR = 1

MR8.value: dexDropLeanOff (2026-10-09, Giggles; BOTH regimes; switch BG157): 1 = Dex↓ removed because the two-sided DEX lean points the other way -- a SUPPORT whose DEX falls off more sharply ABOVE (KU >= BG114 and >= KV + BG115), or a RESISTANCE whose DEX falls off more sharply BELOW. No exemptions (Giggles 2026-10-09: if a level does not earn Dex↓ it does not get it -- no overfitting). A Min GEX + Max Zomma support that loses Dex↓ drops out if nothing else qualifies it; the Max/Min Zomma rule is unchanged. SIGN CROSSING (2026-10-09): if DEX crosses zero on exactly one side (signed fall-off > 100%) and the other side also falls at least BG114, the lean goes to the crossing side whatever the BG115 margin. Removes the backer, confluence point and reversal flag it gave. Archive (25 sessions, Dex↓ first touches): lean-opposed 42% won (n=26) vs 56% (n=70), p 0.26. UNTESTED

MV8.value: spdArrive (2026-10-09, Giggles; BOTH regimes; DISPLAY ONLY): on the Max Speed (BG118) or Min Speed (BG119) strike, ✓ when speed makes its GEX more positive as price ARRIVES (level above spot: price rising into it; below: falling into it) -- speed firms the level; ✗ when it makes GEX more negative -- speed weakens the level and helps price through. Shown after S↑ / S↓ on the ladder. Not counted

MW8.value: dexShoulder (2026-10-09, Giggles; BOTH regimes; setting BG159): 1 = Dex↓ (raw MQ) on a level whose |DEX| is under BG159 x the |DEX| of the strike on the SPOT side of it (below a resistance, above a support) -- the level is only the shoulder of a bigger DEX wall, so Dex↓ is not counted (AJ). Archive (28 sessions, Dex↓ touches): under 50% held 40% (n=20) vs 57%, p 0.17; under 25% 0 of 3. UNTESTED

MX8.value: dexTP (2026-10-09, Giggles; BOTH regimes; DISPLAY ONLY): 2 = the Min DEX strike (BG121, negative DEX) ABOVE spot while a support is in the support rows and the strike is not itself in the resistance rows -- TAKE PROFIT for longs; 1 = the Max DEX strike (BG120, positive DEX) BELOW spot while a resistance is in the resistance rows and the strike is not in the support rows -- TAKE PROFIT for shorts (corrected 2026-10-09, Giggles). Read by LM after the zigzag and GEX-pocket take profits. Not counted

MY8.value: dexLeanUnsafe (2026-10-09, Giggles; NEGATIVE gamma): 1 = the two-sided DEX lean points against the level -- a SUPPORT whose DEX falls off more sharply ABOVE, or a RESISTANCE whose DEX falls off more sharply BELOW (BG114 / BG115, a one-sided zero crossing decides), |DEX| >= BG152 (the iDex floor, 100K; was BG113 150K until 2026-10-09). Not applied to a level with iDex (AV = 1, isolated DEX sign) -- column L notes it. UNSAFE (HQ token DEXLEAN); the vanna override, vanna OK, DOM vanna buy and Min VEX exemptions cannot clear it (HP). Archive (25 neg-gamma sessions, vanna backing the level): DEX lean against held 43% (n=28) vs 56%, p 0.36. UNTESTED
